name: tag-moves
brief: A test reel of playground-tag moves made from sentences (not a story shot): one person on Theodore's grass runs, dodges, tags someone, gets tagged, catches their breath, laughs, and sprints back, about 30 seconds, filmed from the set's own cameras. The moves are cut apart afterwards and played on a crowd of Roosevelts chasing each other across the field.

beats.action: stands easy on the stride mark
is tagged, jumps and spins round
sprints back to the stride mark, reaching ahead
stands easy on the stride mark
